title: EpicSetSpawn
description: Set a starting point for your players in the most fun way!
body:
Set a starting point for your players in the most fun way!



![Banner1](https://i.imgur.com/h3Vs9rq.png) With **EpicSetSpawn** you can set a starting point on your server for all your players. You have messages, customizations, titles, action bars, cooldowns, animations and much more.
![Banner2](https://i.imgur.com/bz4Xr5P.png)
![Banner3](https://i.imgur.com/U3gXK40.png) - /epicspawn ➣ Main command - /spawn ➣ Travel to the spawn. - /epicspawn spawn ➣ Travel to the spawn. - /epicspawn see ➣ Shows where the spawn is placed. - /epicspawn reload ➣ Reloads plugin config. - /epicspawn setspawn ➣ Place the spawn where you are. ![Banner4](https://i.imgur.com/gqPqQl4.png) - epicsetspawn.teleport ➣ Gives access to travel to spawn. - epicsetspawn.reload ➣ Gives access to reload the plugin. - epicsetspawn.setspawn ➣ Gives access to set the spawn. - epicsetspawn.bypass.cooldown ➣ Gives access to bypass the teleport cooldown. - epicsetspawn.see ➣ Gives access to see where the spawn is. ![Banner5](https://i.imgur.com/4ZfEr4L.png) - %timer% ➣ Returns the cooldown seconds

This is my third plugin, if you find any error, bug or improvement proposal you can write it on [Discord](https://discord.gg/ncTMjcNWPx) or [GitHub](https://github.com/Btd20/SetHome/issues). Thanks for download my plugin!
